# netbox_virtual_machine_interfaces (Data Source)

Lists virtual_machine_interface objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_machine_interfaces" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-virtual_machine_interface" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: bridge_id, bridge_id__n, cluster, cluster__n, cluster_id, cluster_id__n, created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, enabled, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, l2vpn, l2vpn__n, l2vpn_id, l2vpn_id__n, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, mac_address, mac_address__ic, mac_address__ie, mac_address__iew, mac_address__iregex, mac_address__isw, mac_address__n, mac_address__nic, mac_address__nie, mac_address__niew, mac_address__nisw, mac_address__regex, mode, mode__empty, mode__ic, mode__ie, mode__iew, mode__iregex, mode__isw, mode__n, mode__nic, mode__nie, mode__niew, mode__nisw, mode__regex, mtu, mtu__empty, mtu__gt, mtu__gte, mtu__lt, mtu__lte, mtu__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner, owner__n, owner_group, owner_group__n, owner_group_id, owner_group_id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, parent_id, parent_id__n, primary_mac_address, primary_mac_address__n, primary_mac_address_id, primary_mac_address_id__n, q, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tag_id, tag_id__any, tag_id__n, virtual_machine, virtual_machine__n, virtual_machine_id, virtual_machine_id__n, vlan, vlan_id, vlan_translation_policy, vlan_translation_policy__n, vlan_translation_policy_id, vlan_translation_policy_id__n, vrf, vrf__n, vrf_id, vrf_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_machine_interfaces` (Attributes List) The matching virtual_machine_interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_machine_interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_machine_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_machine_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `bridge_id` (Number) Id of the bridged interface.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mode` (String) 802.1Q tagging mode. One of: access, tagged, tagged-all, q-in-q.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU in bytes. Must be a whole number.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent interface.
- `qinq_svlan_id` (Number) Id of the Q-in-Q service VLAN.
- `tagged_vlan_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the tagged VLANs.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `untagged_vlan_id` (Number) Id of the untagged VLAN.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) Id of the virtual machine.
- `vlan_translation_policy_id` (Number) Id of the VLAN translation policy.
- `vrf_id` (Number) Id of the VRF.
